checks.label: Cold/hot overlapping ranges preserve every ordered contour edge across positive and negative block seams
Excavation refreshes changed fragments and retains exact movement at chunk seams
Unexplained terrain revisions cannot reuse stale fragments
A fixed 2048-slot ring bounds fragment blocks without whole-cache eviction
A new world clears all fragment geometry and counters
Variable steps and repeated exact footprints match the frozen original movement solver
Repeated footprint recovery is reused independently of requested displacement
A distant excavation keeps an unrelated exact recovery footprint cached
Retained distant recovery still matches the full current terrain query
An intersecting excavation recomputes its exact footprint without keeping stale geometry
Excavation invalidates blocked and clear recovery results
Recovery storage is bounded by a constant-time 512-slot ring
Changing the world clears recovery keys and counters
A new seed cannot reuse a previous world's response

artifacts/cave-sweep-neighborhoods-repor.scope: Exact first contacts through 32px, growing/superset reuse, negative/cell boundary coordinates, inside starts, full-precision radii through 513px, repeated excavation and bounded cache lifetime.

frozen_native_orbit_comparison.scope: Frozen orbit movement queries from native positions/origins/offsets and actual excavated chunks. All captured orbit actors run at 30Hz in this isolated CPU micro-test; remote cadence/rendering/full battle are not replayed.

corrected_recovery_model_comparison.scope: ABBA headless navigation/collision micro-reproducer from recorded root actors. Same procedural seed, mining edits not restored, no rendered FPS claim. Recovery comparison keeps the existing sweep result cache enabled in both paths.
corrected_recovery_model_comparison.speed_model: Base prefab movement speed for Endless Mission; heat only when explicitly captured heat_speed=true. Missing headings use navigation intent, boosts are not restored.

known_limits: 20.64 FPS in final two minutes of full corrected-v1 playthrough; target not met.

Native orbit micro-test restores its captured terrain and freezes identical inputs but uses all orbit actors at 30 Hz; no rendered FPS claim.
